# Onis
Large, horned people that come in a variety of colors. Their accuracy with guns is terrible, but their physical strength brings them a lot of boons both in and out of combat.
## Diet
- Just about anything. Can even eat many things raw.
## Benefits
- They take [color=#1e90ff]15% less Blunt, Pierce, and Slash damage.[/color] - Does more damage in melee; [color=#1e90ff]25% more Blunt, Slash, Pierce, Stamina, and Structural damage.[/color] - Due to their big size, they can easily carry and pull any other species. - They are slowed down [color=#1e90ff]25% less[/color] by clothing. - They heal Brute, Airloss, Poison, and Burn damage very, very slowly when drinking Sake, and can choose to take a refilling Sake gourd with them in their loadouts. Sake also restores some hunger for them.
## Drawbacks
- Oni are [color=#FFA500]unable to fire any weapons accurately[/color], with reports of bullets managing to fire even behind them. - They are harder to carry and pull. - They are bigger than Humans, making them easier to hit. - They get hungry and thirsty much faster than most species. - Starving or being dehydrated deal some poison and airloss damage, and slows you far more than any other species.
